scope: Measured counters in each isolated design run, including follow-ups and native guardian review overhead where present. Calls without recorded counters are excluded; archived setup attempts are excluded.
token_semantics: Counts accumulate across requests, including repeated context. Input includes cache reads and writes; cache columns are subsets. Reported reasoning is a subset of output. Do not add subset columns to input/output. Native counters may differ.
cost_notes: Measured token totals accumulate across requests; context thresholds and published time windows are evaluated per request, never against whole-run totals. Cache reads/writes are subsets of inclusive input; reasoning is a subset of inclusive output. Provider tokenizers may differ. Claude TTL-specific cache-creation counters are deduplicated by message ID; known 1h writes use the 1h rate. API reference endpoints are selected consistently by the published publisher/global Standard policy; rates can change after the stated date. Token prices only; provider-hosted tools, cache storage time, taxes and payment fees are outside this calculation. Missing token counters are not priced.
